name: Wasos file Handling
info:
Prepares downloaded file buffers for the WaSOS JSON POST endpoint.
                                                                                                                                                                                                   
### Input
- msg.payload — WaSOS message body (from Bridge to Wasos)                                                                                                                                        
- msg.metadata.files.items — file objects with .context_key references                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                   
### Logic                                                                                                                                                                                        
Reads pre-downloaded buffers from global context via context_key.                                                                                                                                
Converts each to a NewFileRequest object (filename, extension, filetype, blob).                                                                                                                  
Patches msg.payload.content with failure notice if any files failed.                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                   
### Output                                                                                                                                                                                       
- msg.payload.files — array of NewFileRequest objects ready for JSON POST                                                                                                                        
- msg.metadata.files.failed — updated with any buffer read failures
